newsitem.title: LATVIA: INTERVIEW-C. BANK CHIEF SEES LAT SLIGHTLY UNDERVALUED.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-C. BANK CHIEF SEES LAT SLIGHTLY UNDERVALUED.

text.p: Latvian Central Bank governor Einar Repshe on Wednesday said the Latvian currency was slightly undervalued.
Repshe also said he envisaged three to five bank merger cases and three to five possible bank closures in 1998 as banks are obliged to raise their minimum capital levels.
"My guess is that the lat is still slightly undervalued," Repshe told Reuters in an interview.
Repshe said that in 1998 banks had to raise their capital from one million to two million lats.
He said this would lead to mergers and bank closures.
Repshe said there would be merger cases that would apply to three to five banks and he enviasged between three and five single bank closures.
Repshe said the closures would be carried out in a "civilised" manner with the banks meeting their liabilities and shareholders receiving some of their funds bank.
